recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to light gray (#F5F5F5).
2. Draw a thick dark-red (#8B0000) rectangular border framing the entire content area, inset with a small even margin from all slide edges.
3. Place the main title 'Regression – One Dimensional Case' centered at the top of the frame (~5–15% of slide height), in large bold sans-serif dark red (#8B0000).
4. Place a yellow (#FFFF99) circular badge in the top-right corner containing the black number '4'.
5. Place the chart title 'Length and Weight of  different samples of Steel Bars' (keep the double space after 'of') centered below the main title at ~20% of slide height, in bold blue (#0000CC) sans-serif.
6. Draw the scatter plot in the center-left area (~10–70% of slide width, ~25–90% of slide height): a vertical red arrow axis on the left and a horizontal red arrow axis at the bottom, with no tick marks or numeric values; label the y-axis 'Weight' in bold red (#8B0000) text rotated 90° beside the left axis, and label the x-axis 'Length' in bold red (#8B0000) at the bottom right of the plot.
7. Plot approximately 20 orange-brown (#D2691E) circular dots forming a positive linear trend from lower-left to upper-right (exact count not specified in the source).
8. Draw a vertical purple (#800080) dashed line rising from a purple (#800080) dot placed on the x-axis at roughly 60% of the plot width, up to near the top of the data cloud.
9. Draw exactly 4 horizontal purple (#800080) dashed lines extending left from points on/near the vertical dashed line to the y-axis, each ending in a purple (#800080) dot on the y-axis.
10. Stack exactly 4 bold red (#8B0000) question marks '? ? ? ?' vertically beside the 4 y-axis dots.
11. Draw a thin brown (#A0522D) dotted vertical line slightly to the right of the purple dashed line, and thin brown (#A0522D) dotted horizontal lines running from the y-axis to the data points near the vertical line (count not specified in the source).
12. Add a small black mouse-cursor arrow icon at the center of the plot, pointing at the data point near the vertical dashed line (this element is present in the source imagery and is required, not optional).
13. Add a white (#FFFFFF) rectangular box with a thin border at the right-middle of the plot area (~72–85% of slide width, ~40–55% of slide height) containing three lines: 'Model' in bold underlined dark red (#8B0000), 'I/P:  Length' in bold black (#000000) (keep the double space after the colon), and 'O/P: Weight' in bold black (#000000).
